faqs.question: What is the StorageBlue Growth Fund?
faqs.answer: The StorageBlue Growth Fund, LP (SBGF) is a $350 million equity fund focused on self-storage acquisitions, developments, and value-add redevelopment projects. It represents up to $1 billion in buying power through a vertically integrated development and operations model.

faqs.question: Who founded the StorageBlue Growth Fund?
faqs.answer: The fund was founded by Alan Mruvka, founder of E! Entertainment Television and a 35-year veteran in real estate and self-storage. Winston Ma, CFA, Esq., former Managing Director at China Investment Corporation, serves as Chief Investment Officer.

faqs.question: What markets does StorageBlue focus on?
faqs.answer: The fund initially focuses on the New York and New Jersey metropolitan area, one of the most supply-constrained self-storage markets in the U.S., before expanding to other high-demand regions.

faqs.question: What is the fund's track record?
faqs.answer: The StorageBlue platform has developed over 3.5 million square feet of self-storage space across 25 NYC/NJ facilities. A recent 6-facility portfolio sale achieved a $100M sale price, 33.79% average levered IRR, and 17.14% unlevered IRR.

faqs.question: What is the investment horizon?
faqs.answer: The StorageBlue Growth Fund targets a 5-year investment horizon.

faqs.question: How can I invest in the StorageBlue Growth Fund?
faqs.answer: Accredited and institutional investors can request access through the Investor Login page at storagebluecapital.com/auth or contact the investor relations team via the contact form to schedule a call.
